import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess,shutil
repo=pathlib.Path('/workspace/r5-u06-review');a=repo/'review/remediation-fifth-20261013-prepare/candidates/R5-U06/author';c=json.loads((repo/'review/remediation-fifth-20261013-prepare/contracts/R5-U06/contract.json').read_text());m=json.loads((a/'candidate-manifest.json').read_text());e=json.loads((a/'edits.json').read_text())
def ident(b):return dict(bytes=len(b),sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),git_blob=hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(b)).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest())
def show(commit,p):return subprocess.check_output(['git','show',commit+':'+p],cwd=repo)
fixed={'freeze':'22fba7786b0090a1955ce6211315b0036cddfbcd','candidate':'f393d261c8ab1660323d8b32fe4a7d81c33e3e2c','evidence':'bc2b9f77fffe81e618bf7ef0ca2573fc7816e8a7'}
checks=[]; targets=[]; originals={}
for r in m['proposed_targets']:
 target=r['target'];base=show(c['fixed_inputs']['B5']['commit'],target);assert ident(base)==r['B5_identity'];originals[target]=base
 rebuilt=base.decode()
 for edit in [x for x in e if x['target']==target]:
  assert edit['B5_blob']==r['B5_identity']['git_blob'];assert edit['B5_anchor']==edit['before'];assert rebuilt.count(edit['before'])==1;rebuilt=rebuilt.replace(edit['before'],edit['after'],1)
 data=rebuilt.encode();i=ident(data);assert i==dict(bytes=r['proposed_bytes'],sha256=r['proposed_sha256'],git_blob=r['proposed_git_blob']);assert (pathlib.Path('/tmp/r5-u06-replay-independent')/target).read_bytes()==data
 if r['mode']=='direct_mirror':assert show(fixed['candidate'],r['candidate_path'])==data
 targets.append(dict(target=target,mode=r['mode'],candidate_path=r['candidate_path'],base_identity=ident(base),proposed_identity=i,findings=r['finding_ids'],status='TOOL_VALIDATION_OK'))
patchdir=pathlib.Path('/tmp/r5-u06-patch-independent');patchdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for target,base in originals.items():f=patchdir/target;f.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);f.write_bytes(base)
p=subprocess.run(['git','apply','--unidiff-zero','--unsafe-paths',str(a/'formal-diff.patch')],cwd=patchdir,capture_output=True,text=True);assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
for r in targets:assert ident((patchdir/r['target']).read_bytes())==r['proposed_identity']
# Shared proposal files are complete generated fragments rather than live shared changes.
f=json.loads((a/'fragment-manifest.json').read_text())['fragments'];assert len(f)==15
for r in f:
 match=next(x for x in e if x['edit_id']==r['edit_id']);assert all(r[k]==match[k] for k in ['target','before','after','finding_ids','B5_blob','B5_anchor']);assert all(v=='WAIT' for v in r['dependencies'].values())
artifacts=[]
for r in m['artifacts']:
 b=show(fixed['candidate'],r['path']);assert ident(b)=={k:r[k] for k in ['bytes','sha256','git_blob']};artifacts.append(dict(path=r['path'],identity=ident(b),commit=fixed['candidate'],read='full_payload_hash_validation'))
for p in [str(a.relative_to(repo)/'candidate-manifest.json'),str(a.relative_to(repo)/'publication-evidence.json')]:
 commit=fixed['evidence'] if p.endswith('publication-evidence.json') else fixed['candidate'];b=show(commit,p);artifacts.append(dict(path=p,identity=ident(b),commit=commit,read='full_payload_hash_validation'))
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',fixed['candidate']+':deliverables/final-specification-set'],cwd=repo,text=True).strip()==c['fixed_inputs']['B5']['formal_tree']
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',fixed['evidence']+':deliverables/final-specification-set'],cwd=repo,text=True).strip()==c['fixed_inputs']['B5']['formal_tree']
response=json.loads((a/'finding-responses.json').read_text());vectors=json.loads((a/'static-vectors.json').read_text())['vectors'];packet=json.loads((repo/'review/remediation-fifth-20261013-prepare/contracts/R5-U06/task-packet.json').read_text())
assert len(response['findings'])==18 and len(vectors)==106
count=0
for finding in packet['findings']:
 fid=finding['id'];criteria=finding['acceptance_criteria']['static'];out=next(x for x in response['findings'] if x['id']==fid)
 assert [x.get('criterion',x.get('text')) for x in out['mandatory_criteria']]==[t for v in finding['acceptance_criteria'].values() for t in (v if isinstance(v,list) else [v])];count+=len(out['mandatory_criteria'])
 assert {x['target'] for x in e if fid in x['finding_ids']}==set(c['per_finding_formal_permissions'][fid])
assert count==145
result=dict(evidence_level='TOOL_VALIDATION',behavior_executions=0,reference_executions=0,model_executions=0,host_demo_executions=0,targets=targets,artifacts=artifacts,checks=[dict(name='independent_rebuild_from_B5_full_anchors',status='PASS',targets=24,edits=43),dict(name='independent_zero_context_git_apply',status='PASS',targets=24),dict(name='fragments_match_edits',status='PASS',fragments=15,shared_targets=10),dict(name='full_candidate_artifact_identities',status='PASS',count=len(artifacts)),dict(name='exact_frozen_criteria_and_permissions',status='PASS',findings=18,criteria=145,vectors=106),dict(name='protected_formal_tree',status='PASS',tree=c['fixed_inputs']['B5']['formal_tree'])])
pathlib.Path('/tmp/r5-u06-review/tool-validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ['targets','artifacts']},ensure_ascii=False))
